live_qa.evidence: release-evidence/verdicts.json. FAIL_LIVE first, honestly, because the anonymous contact budget had already been spent from the shared public address by the release manager's own verification, so the anonymisation check could not reach the code under test. Re-verified against the deployed origin, which is a separate rate-limit client: the submission returned anonymized:true and the signed-in queue showed Demo visitor / visitor-3@example.invalid / Demonstration request rather than the submitted identity. Production was left at the seeded baseline, 73% and 33 of 49 passing.

validation.restart_or_reboot_evidence: The application was updated in place with restart: unless-stopped and has run from a single start since. Seed idempotency across restart is covered by the readiness check and by the reseed being wrapped in one transaction.
validation.identity_contract_evidence: Configured and active image digest, /app read-only and /data read-write mount modes, source digest and release revision verified against the compose specification after the job completed. The ungate additionally required the live service to report the expected version and release commit at the origin before the Access application was deleted, and again through the public hostname afterwards.
validation.release_base_alignment_evidence: releasectl check-base PASS: the deployed revision c01fbed was read from the live service and is an ancestor of HEAD, no other worktree owns the release target, and HEAD is not behind origin/main.
validation.production_platform_build_evidence: No platform image is built by this release. The runtime is the unmodified upstream node:24-slim pinned by digest, and it was proven fit before freeze by running the full application test suite inside that exact image on linux/amd64 with the source mounted read-only.
validation.invariant_contracts_evidence: PASS - 5/5 via node scripts/verify-invariants.mjs, each proven able to fail
validation.dependency_live_probe_evidence: PASS - registry digest, node:sqlite runtime, midclt, Cloudflare credential, tunnel ingress and DNS each probed live with a distinguishing negative control
validation.secret_artifact_sweep_evidence: The service holds, mounts and reads no secret material; the compose environment contains only version metadata and feature flags. The full git history was searched for credential patterns before the repository was made public and none was found. The published demonstration password vantage123 is deliberate and documented. Estate topology present in the repository — the RFC1918 origin address and the Cloudflare account, tunnel and identity-provider identifiers — was reviewed by the security lane and accepted as non-credential.
validation.functional_smoke_evidence: Production browser journey through the loopback forward: real form sign-in, dashboard, monitoring, remediation flipped a failing test to passing and the dashboard passing count rose 33->34, Trust Center rendered with no undefined/NaN, auditor read 200 / write 403, mobile horizontal overflow 0px, zero console errors. Tenant then reset to the documented baseline of 33/49.
validation.pre_deploy_summary_evidence: 30/30 tests pass locally and inside the pinned image on linux/amd64 with /app read-only; 5/5 invariants hold including frontend build parity against the commit; 23 client routes render with zero console errors; responsive verified at 390/768/1440.
validation.assigned_user_journey_evidence: Exercised through the public hostname from the consumer position: signed in with the published demonstration admin, read the dashboard (73%, 33/49 passing), remediated device-encryption, and readiness moved to 75% with 34/49 passing. The auditor account was refused the same mutation with 403, and an anonymous caller received 401. The demonstration was then reset to its seeded baseline and re-verified at 73%, 33/49.
validation.public_edge_verification_evidence: edgectl PASS. Every public path answers 200 anonymously; /api/dashboard answers 401 as the in-boundary negative control; both content-hashed assets are served immutable under their literal published hrefs; DNS converged across four resolvers; the wildcard certificate covers the name at one-label depth. The strongest negative control is the same hostname minutes earlier, when /api/public/config returned the Cloudflare Access sign-in page instead of JSON.
validation.cleanup_manifest_evidence: cleanupctl PASS at pre-deploy and at post-release, with proven absence for every temporary object

exceptions.reason: Seeded demonstration accounts share a documented password that is displayed on the login page, so application authentication provides no defence in depth on its own.
exceptions.compensating_control: Cloudflare Access gates every path with Entra SSO or one-time PIN restricted to the mytechie.com.au email domain; the data is entirely fictional; sign-in is throttled to 10 failures per account per 15 minutes; the password is no longer pre-filled.

exceptions.owner: Principal Platform SRE and Release Engineer
exceptions.reason: The release credential lacks the Cloudflare Access Service Tokens permission, so an authenticated smoke test through the public edge using a service token was unavailable.
exceptions.compensating_control: Public verification proved every path returns the Access redirect with a distinguishing negative control, and the authenticated journey was exercised in a real browser against the production origin through a loopback forward that was terminated afterwards.

exceptions.reason: The Trust Center document access-request endpoint is unauthenticated and unthrottled, so it could be spammed.
exceptions.compensating_control: Cloudflare Access fronts the path, so no anonymous internet caller can reach it; the endpoint validates all fields and writes only a request row.

assurance.architecture_delta_evidence: Express removed in favour of a zero-dependency node:http router so the release can be bind-mounted read-only into a stock image with no install step; web/dist committed so the artifact equals the commit; health and readiness endpoints added for origin monitoring.
assurance.workflow_health_evidence: 30 automated tests plus 5 executable invariants run from the repository; each new regression test was proven to fail without its fix.
assurance.security_posture_evidence: Two review lanes returned REVISE and were remediated: role enforcement, header-only sessions, sign-in throttling, reduced public disclosure, remediation column allow-list, whole-segment auth guard and consistent path normalisation. Both lanes then returned APPROVE.
assurance.test_traceability_evidence: Every review finding carries a named regression test: SEC-1 role model, SEC-2 query-string token, SEC-3 throttling, SEC-4 public disclosure, ENG-L2 guard segmentation, ENG-M1 readiness write probe.
assurance.observability_baseline_evidence: Origin /healthz and /readyz are the monitoring signals and are documented in the README as such because the public path is Access gated. Readiness proven to fail closed: with /data mounted read-only on Linux the process stays up and /readyz returns 503 with database_writable false.

recovery.rollback_point: release c01fbed090274a8b9629e68bd1b7dfe68f112b69, whose source directory is retained on the host
recovery.rollback_procedure: Three independent axes: (1) python3 scripts/publishctl.py regate restores the identity gate at the edge in one command and is the fastest containment for abuse; (2) midclt call -j app.update pinned back to the c01fbed release directory and the 1.0.0 environment; (3) zfs.rollback to TailsPool/vantage@pre-1.1.0 if data must be restored. The repository can be re-privatised with PATCH /repos/phamid/vantage {"private": true}, with the caveat that clones and forks cannot be recalled.
recovery.last_known_good: c01fbed090274a8b9629e68bd1b7dfe68f112b69 (vantage 1.0.0), source directory retained on the host
recovery.rollback_command:
python3 scripts/publishctl.py regate   # restore the identity gate first, fastest containment
ssh nas1 "midclt call -j app.update vantage '<payload pinning /mnt/TailsPool/vantage/releases/c01fbed090274a8b9629e68bd1b7dfe68f112b69 and the 1.0.0 environment>'"
ssh nas1 "midclt call zfs.rollback '{\"id\":\"TailsPool/vantage@pre-1.1.0\"}'"   # only if data must be restored
